method: Macro v7 plus aligned broadcast geometric P(D), a 50-frame phase-edge decode, and pointwise retention of v7 alive-team labels inside each matching held-out head.

experiments.frame_change_reference_for_initial_scree: macro_v5; paired audit uses each corresponding macro_v7 baseline

limitations: All model and method selection reuses the same 17 public possessions.
Six-fold macro-F1 falls by 0.001797; three/four/five-fold macro-F1 rises.
Spell-F1 improves at four/five folds and stays equal at three/six.
Repartitioning is sensitivity on the same slice, not independent validation.
Three ground-truth possessions remain missed; the spell gain removes a spurious prediction.
Away class F1 decreases slightly at five folds while H and D improve.
Broadcast geometry and clock matching are imperfect; the quality gate rejects inconsistent views.
The 50-frame phase bound preserves fixed D cores and primary video coverage.
No private, unseen-match or full-match accuracy is known.
Models, raw geometry, alignment maps, features and output labels remain gitignored.
